## Sphere Bot 1.0.9

- Use the new Workspace icon consistently in the Windows taskbar, tray and shortcuts.
- Install through a branded setup screen with a simple flow and no directory-selection page.
- Show progress during Restart to Update and reopen Sphere Bot visibly when installation finishes.
- Fix update verification when Windows PowerShell cannot load Get-FileHash.

This release preserves existing accounts, conversations and settings.
